newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KPW CLEARS ZREW FOR PUBLIC TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KPW CLEARS ZREW FOR PUBLIC TRADE.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared all 868,120 shares of repairer of power equipment maker Zaklady Remontowe Energetyki Warszawa SA (ZREW) for public trade, KPW said in a statement on Thursday.
The president of the company, which did not plan to carry out a public offering before entering the bourse, said the firm was likely to enter the exchange in April.
"I think the debut will be in April," Pawel Rychter said.
The firm, which seeks a parallel market's listing, had a net profit of 2.5 million zlotys on sales of 60 million zlotys last year.
Its largest shareholder is the state treasury, which has 12.9 percent of shares.
